records.text: The annual staff forum is booked at Atlas House on 20 August, 08:00-18:00. Both floors have been reserved.

The forum on 20 August will now be held at the civic centre. Every team will work from there for the day. Please release the Atlas rooms and leave the building on its out-of-hours settings until the next morning.
For the 25 August course, 18:00-22:00, use the two rooms upstairs at Atlas House. Nothing has been booked on the ground floor.
Upper floor access is confirmed for the course; the other floor stays closed. Fresh-air service will be enabled until the attendees leave at 22:00.
On 29 August, 08:00-12:00, run the Atlas air-handling plant through its flushing cycle. Start and stop will be done over the remote connection. No visit or room access is required.
Do not put the building into occupied mode for the contractor's job. Office lighting and plug loads should stay on the normal weekend settings.
On 2 September the teams based upstairs will leave at noon for an off-site workshop and not return that afternoon. The ground-floor teams continue as usual.
The North and South areas will be secured after lunch. East and West remain available to staff until the usual closing time; the central fresh-air system keeps its ordinary schedule.
On 7 September staff should work remotely until lunchtime. The office opens at 12:00 instead of 08:00.
Keep Atlas House on overnight settings through the morning, including the air-handling plant. Resume the normal weekday arrangement at noon.
A Saturday session is proposed for Atlas House on 12 September, 12:00-16:00, using the whole ground floor.
Attendance is smaller than expected. Only East will be needed for that session; please release West. No one needs the upper floor.
Access for East and the central fresh-air run are confirmed for 12:00-16:00. The remainder of Atlas stays on weekend settings.
On 17 September, 18:00-22:00, the briefing will use both upstairs areas and the East studio downstairs. West is excluded.
Those areas will remain accessible after the normal close, with the air-handling plant left running until 22:00.
Please perform the Atlas ventilation flush from midnight to 08:00 on 20 September. The engineer will operate it from home.
No attendance or access is scheduled at Atlas for the flush. Keep all office areas on their usual Sunday settings.
Quarterly planning at Atlas House on 23 September, 08:00-18:00; all teams attending.
We have transferred quarterly planning to River Annex. All Atlas staff should report there and remain there for the working day. Atlas House itself should stay in its weekend arrangement throughout.
On 29 September, after the midday break, all teams except the East studio group will work from home. Nobody from the other areas will come back before closing.
Only East will remain available from 12:00 to 18:00. The common mechanical ventilation stays on its normal daytime programme.
The 3 October workshop runs 08:00-12:00 at Atlas House. The initial upstairs booking has been replaced by the ground-floor arrangement.
East and West will be opened for the workshop, with fresh-air service during attendance. North and South stay closed.
Evening review at Atlas House on 8 October, 18:00-22:00. Both floors tentatively reserved.
The review has split across sites. At Atlas only West is required; everyone else will be at River Annex. Please release the other Atlas areas.
West access and the central ventilation run are confirmed until 22:00. Other Atlas zones stay closed after the normal working day.
The 13 October planning workshop will use both floors of Atlas House from 12:00 to 18:00.
We have accepted the town hall's offer to host the afternoon workshop. Everyone at Atlas should head there after lunch and finish the day there. The earlier room reservation can be released.
For that afternoon, put Atlas on its normal out-of-hours arrangement from noon. There is no separate cleaning or engineering run; reopen on the usual schedule the following morning.
Atlas House is reserved for the evening seminar on 15 October, 18:00-22:00. Both floors were requested.

Revised venue split: the upper-floor groups will meet at River Annex. The session remaining at Atlas needs the ground floor only, including both rooms. The earlier whole-building request no longer applies.
Keep access and fresh-air service for the Atlas session until 22:00, with the upstairs areas secured after the usual close.
Air-system commissioning at Atlas House, 17 October, 08:00-12:00. A technician visit was provisionally requested.
The site visit is no longer needed. We will complete that commissioning window through the remote controls. The air-handling plant must still run for the full window; no room will be used.
No access has been arranged. Leave the office areas on weekend settings while the remote run takes place.
